categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies shared span utilities in src/span.h to add compile-time lifetime annotations and range constraints.
categories.rationale: Adds Clang lifetime annotations to MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan to diagnose dangling views of temporary owning objects at compile time. While improving the safety of core utility primitives by catching misuse early, it does not fix an active bug or affect runtime behavior.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: The change in src/dbwrapper.cpp merely marks leveldb::Slice as a borrowed range to satisfy concept checks in the span utility, without changing validation logic.
categories.rationale: Does not substantively alter validation or dbwrapper behavior; editing dbwrapper is purely mechanical to support utility lifetime annotations.
